Complete guide: vitamins: which ones are included and why and Grüns

Understanding the role of vitamins

Vitamins are organic compounds that our bodies need in small amounts to function optimally. They act as co‑enzymes, antioxidants, and regulators of metabolic pathways. Without adequate vitamin intake, the risk of fatigue, weakened immunity, and long‑term health issues increases.

Vitamins packed into Grüns greens gummies

Grüns has formulated its gummies with a balanced blend of essential vitamins sourced from plant‑based ingredients. The goal is to provide a convenient, tasty way to support daily nutrition.

  • Vitamin A (Beta‑carotene)
  • Vitamin C (Ascorbic acid)
  • Vitamin D3 (Lichen‑derived)
  • Vitamin E (Mixed tocopherols)
  • B‑Complex (B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B7, B9, B12)

Vitamin A – Vision, immunity, and skin health

Vitamin A, present in Grüns as beta‑carotene, is a precursor that the body converts into retinol when needed. Retinol supports the retina, helping maintain clear night vision. It also strengthens the mucous membranes that line the respiratory and digestive tracts, providing a first line of defense against pathogens. Additionally, vitamin A promotes healthy skin turnover, which can improve texture and tone.

Key food sources and synergy

While carrots, sweet potatoes, and leafy greens are classic sources, the beta‑carotene in Grüns gummies offers a reliable, plant‑based boost that complements a balanced diet.

Vitamin C – Powerful antioxidant and immune booster

Vitamin C is celebrated for its antioxidant capacity, neutralizing free radicals that can damage cells. In Grüns gummies, vitamin C also enhances the absorption of iron from plant foods, supports collagen synthesis for joint and skin health, and shortens the duration of common colds by supporting white‑blood‑cell function.

Why the gummy form matters

The chewable format of Grüns helps protect vitamin C from oxidative loss that can occur during cooking or storage of fresh produce, ensuring you receive a potent dose each day.

Vitamin D3 – The sunshine vitamin for bones and mood

Vitamin D3 in Grüns is derived from lichen, making it suitable for vegans. This form of vitamin D assists calcium absorption in the intestines, which is critical for maintaining strong bones and teeth. Emerging research also links adequate vitamin D levels to improved mood and reduced risk of seasonal affective disorder.

Daily needs and safety

Because the body can store vitamin D, Grüns provides a moderate amount that aligns with recommended daily allowances, reducing the risk of excessive intake while still delivering benefits.

Vitamin E – Protecting cells and supporting skin

Vitamin E, supplied as mixed tocopherols in Grüns, acts as a lipid‑soluble antioxidant. It protects cell membranes from oxidative damage, particularly in skin cells exposed to UV radiation. This protection can help maintain skin elasticity and reduce the appearance of fine lines.

Combined antioxidant effect

When paired with vitamin C, vitamin E creates a regeneration cycle that enhances overall antioxidant efficiency, offering broader protection against oxidative stress.

B‑Complex – Energy production and nervous system health

The B‑complex vitamins in Grüns cover the full spectrum from B1 (thiamine) to B12 (cobalamin). Each plays a distinct role:

  • B1 – Converts glucose into energy, supports nerve function.
  • B2 – Essential for cellular growth and red blood cell production.
  • B3 – Aids metabolism and skin health.
  • B5 – Co‑enzyme A precursor, vital for fatty acid synthesis.
  • B6 – Involved in neurotransmitter synthesis and hormone regulation.
  • B7 – Supports hair, skin, and nail health.
  • B9 – Critical for DNA synthesis and fetal development.
  • B12 – Necessary for nerve sheath formation and red blood cell formation.

Together, these vitamins help convert the food you eat into usable energy, reduce fatigue, and maintain a healthy nervous system.

Synergy with other nutrients

Grüns blends B‑vitamins with vitamin C and magnesium from plant extracts, creating a supportive environment for optimal metabolic function.

How Grüns blends these vitamins for optimal absorption

Grüns uses a proprietary process that coats each vitamin with a natural, plant‑based carrier. This technique protects sensitive vitamins like vitamin C from degradation and promotes gradual release in the digestive tract. The result is a more consistent absorption rate compared with traditional chewable tablets.

Digestive comfort

The gummies are formulated to be gentle on the stomach. They contain no artificial colors, flavors, or excessive sugars, making them suitable for most dietary preferences.

Choosing the right portion for your lifestyle

Most adults benefit from one to two gummies per day, depending on individual nutritional needs and dietary gaps. It is advisable to assess your current vitamin intake from foods and consider any specific health goals when determining the appropriate amount
